rows.note: For a news, magazine, or other nonfiction piece, 文章 is the all-purpose choice.

example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 gei2 jau5 ceoi3

rows.note: Use 物件 for a physical object or item, including an article of clothing viewed as an object.

example.english: This article was a gift from my mother.
example.traditional: 呢件物件係我阿媽送畀我嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 mat6 gin6 hai6 ngo5 aa3 maa1 sung3 bei2 ngo5 ge3

rows.note: Use 項目 for an item in a list, category, or group rather than a physical object.

example.english: Every article on the list has a price.
example.traditional: 張清單上面每個項目都有價錢。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 cing1 daan1 soeng6 min6 mui5 go3 hong6 muk6 dou1 jau5 gaa3 cin2

rows.note: Use 冠詞 when discussing grammatical articles such as English a, an, and the.

example.english: In English, an article can be definite or indefinite.
example.traditional: 英文入面嘅冠詞可以係定冠詞或者不定冠詞。
example.jyutping: jing1 man4 jap6 min6 ge3 gun3 ci4 ho2 ji5 hai6 ding6 gun3 ci4 waak6 ze2 bat1 ding6 gun3 ci4
